text: PART III - LANDS Title Registration REGISTRATION OF TITLE ACT, No. 21 OF 1998 Declaration of Determination of the Commissioner of Title Settlement under Section 14 BY virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 14 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998, I, the undersigned, hereby declare my determination as set out in the Schedule appended hereto in regard to the title to parcel of Land Nos. 1 : 2, 1 : 4, 1 : 29, 1 : 46, 1 : 118, 1 : 134 and 1 : 143 of Block 1, contained in the Cadastral Map No. 810260, situated in the Village of Pedinnoruwa within the Grama Niladhari Division of No. 135E - Handugoda in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Akmeemana, in the District of Galle, in the Province of Southern, referred to in Notice No. 81/0263 calling for claims to land parcels which was duly published in the Gazette No. 2295/41 of 02nd September, 2022 in terms of Section 12 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998.
